description: Wallet due diligence for any EVM address on Ethereum or Base: native balance, recent transactions with counterparties, top token holdings with USD values when known, plus anomaly flags for burst activity, concentrated outflows and contract wallets. For counterparty screening, airdrop eligibility checks, portfolio snapshots, or checking a wallet before transacting with it. Sources: public indexers (Blockscout, Etherscan) with on-chain RPC fallback; responses state sources and data_quality.
name: wallet-activity-summary
